name: Mayor's Office
notes: Includes sub-offices that vary by year (e.g. homeland security, criminal justice coordination, economic development)

name: Chief Administrative Office
notes: Includes information technology and other central services in most years

name: Department of Finance
notes: Bureaus of accounting, purchasing, revenue, treasury and retirement

name: Office of Training Division
notes: Dormant line: 0 in nearly every year; 6,394 FY2004 actual and 9,007,366 FY2013 actual (unexplained, printed in 2015-2018 books); no budget-year amounts

name: Orleans Parish Communication District
notes: 911 call centre

name: Office of Police Secondary Employment
notes: Has its own statement line only in the FY2024-actuals table of the 2026 adopted book (14.6M). In all budget-year statements its page is inside Miscellaneous (Misc = CAO misc page + NORDC + Risk Management + this office). The 2025 adopted/proposed and 2026 proposed books print the Miscellaneous total under this label in places; those rows are mapped to miscellaneous.

name: Office of Independent Police Monitor
notes: Own statement line from the 2017 book; before that inside the Inspector General programs.

name: Office of Inspector General
notes: Printed as 'General Services' in the statements until the 2021 book and as Office of the Inspector General from the 2022 book; included the Ethics Review Board (and, until FY2016, the Independent Police Monitor programs) until they got own lines (2017 book).

name: Ethics Review Board
notes: Own statement line from the 2017 book; before that included in the line printed 'General Services' (Inspector General).

name: Orleans Parish Sheriff
notes: Printed as Criminal Sheriff; runs the jail

name: Municipal and Traffic Court
notes: Municipal Court and Traffic Court were separate until they merged; both map here

name: Human Services (Juvenile Justice Intervention Center)
notes: Runs the youth detention centre; printed as Human Services or JJIC

name: Code Enforcement
notes: Own statement line from the 2024 book on. FY2021-2023 books carry it inside the Office of Community Development line (OCD - Code Enforcement page); earlier years not verified (presumably Safety and Permits).

name: Mosquito, Termite and Rodent Control Board
Health Department
notes: Includes Emergency Medical Services in the citywide statements (the 2026 book's FY2024 actuals table prints EMS separately; 2019-2020 and 2025+ pages show Health + EMS = statement line)

name: Recreation
notes: The Recreation Department. Own statement line with real amounts to FY2012, near zero FY2013-14, 0 afterwards (line ends in the 2020 book). From FY2013 its successor, the New Orleans Recreation Development Commission (NORDC programs 7001-7007, later 'Misc- NORD', later NORDC page), is budgeted inside Miscellaneous.

name: Office of Community Development
notes: Later the Office of Housing and Community Development; mostly federal grants. Printed 'Neighborhood 1' in the 2008-09 books. Includes Code Enforcement in the FY2021-2023 books.

name: Workforce Investment
notes: Federal job-training grants

name: Miscellaneous
notes: Citywide costs not assigned to a department; contents vary by year. From FY2013 includes NORDC (the former Recreation); in 2021-2027 books equals CAO misc page + NORDC + Risk Management + Office of Police Secondary Employment.

name: Intergovernmental
notes: Pass-through and grant placeholder amounts

name: New Orleans Aviation Board
notes: The airport

name: New Orleans Building Corporation
notes: No citywide-statement line in any book; appears only as a department section

name: Other
notes: Lines that fit no department (e.g. Payroll Error Suspense)
